description: Suggest existing context libraries that look relevant to a workflow you are about to create, ranked by keyword overlap between the workflow name/description and each library's name/description. Call this BEFORE create_workflow (or create type=workflow) so you can present the matches to the user and let them choose which to attach via projectIds. Nothing is auto-attached — these are suggestions only. Returns [] when no libraries score above zero.

description.description: The workflow description, if any — improves match quality.

name.description: The name of the workflow being created.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. If not provided, uses your default workspace.

name: suggest_libraries
